plugins.prepareCmd: npx @vscode/vsce pack -m "chore: publish version ${nextRelease.version} to marketplace" --no-yarn --no-git-tag-version --githubBranch main ${nextRelease.version} -o djpai.jinjaform-${nextRelease.version}.vsix
plugins.publishCmd: npx @vscode/vsce publish --oidc -m "chore: publish version ${nextRelease.version} to marketplace" --no-yarn --no-git-tag-version --githubBranch main -i djpai.jinjaform-${nextRelease.version}.vsix
